thread.title: Apple Seen Launching New AirPods Wireless Earbuds In Early 2019 | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Seen Launching New AirPods Wireless Earbuds In Early 2019 | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) will launch a new version of AirPods, its popular wireless earbuds, in the first quarter next year, according to a respected analyst. The new AirPods will support wireless charging, he said.
X TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo predicted the new AirPods in a report to clients late last week. He also expects Apple to release a completely redesigned version of the wireless earbuds in early 2020.
He forecast dramatic growth of unit sales for the iPhone accessory. Kuo estimates that Apple will ship 26 million to 28 million units this year, up from 14 million to 16 million in 2017, CNBC reported Monday .
The new AirPods could propel unit shipments to 50 million to 55 million units next year, 70 million to 80 million units in 2020 and 100 million to 110 million units in 2021, Kuo said.

Please contact customer service CLOSE AirPods Part Of Fast-Growing Wearables Business "Over 1 billion iPhone users worldwide offer great potential growth opportunities for AirPods," Kuo said. "We believe that there is a greater likelihood of legacy iPhone users buying AirPods than upgrading to new iPhone models."
The current AirPods cost $159 a pair and come with a wired charging case. They can work with the iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac computers.
People use AirPods for listening to music, making and receiving phone calls, and summoning the Siri personal assistant. AirPods have Bluetooth wireless to connect to other Apple devices.
Apple Chief Executive Tim Cook touted the company's fast-growing wearable device business in its September-quarter report on Nov. 1.
"With revenue growth over 50%, it was another record quarter for wearables, which includes Apple Watch, AirPods and Beats products," he said on a conference call with analysts.
Apple stock rose 3.5% to 184.82 on the stock market today .
